_comment: TASK-0285. First provenance record for EvoEF2 -- none existed before this task (unlike tools/fpocket/PROVENANCE.json, no prior cross-machine drift had been checked). Regenerate after any Dockerfile rebuild and diff against this file before trusting a new run.
platform: linux/amd64 (via Docker Desktop emulation on this arm64 host)
source_recipe: README.md's own pinned recipe: git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/tommyhuangthu/EvoEF2.git, apply task0204_single_pass_repack.patch, g++ -O3 -o EvoEF2 src/*.cpp
container_binary_sha256_caveat: Linux ELF, not comparable byte-for-byte to a native macOS Mach-O build's own sha256 -- the reproducibility check that matters is the OUTPUT, not the binary hash, see below.

reproducibility_check.method: GreedyRepack on KRAS_G12C (4LDJ, chain A, 170 residues), native macOS arm64 binary (EvoEF2.native-backup, the binary this Dockerfile's own wrapper replaced) vs. this image's own containerized binary, identical input PDB, identical command
reproducibility_check.result: BYTE-IDENTICAL output (_beststruct.pdb, 107203 bytes both arms) -- a clean positive, unlike tools/fpocket/PROVENANCE.json's own containerized_build_TASK_0285 entry, which found a real discrepancy for that tool. Not assumed to generalize to every target/command without further testing -- one real target checked, reported as what it is.
